adversarial_cases.expected: Three creditor classes by three scenarios, nine known marks; Base all 100.0%, Downside 100.0 / 18.7 / 18.7, Stress 74.2 / 0.0 / 0.0 (the points carry the settled texts); zero recoveries are known zeros plotted at zero.
T4E.5.v0Neq.recovery is not_applicable (n.m.): no mark, no twin cell, no gap mark; the series and twin contain creditor classes only (item 6).

A missing administrative claim (c02) blocks its rank group and every lower rank: recoveries for c02-c04 are gap marks with the module reason, c01 Base and Downside stay 100.0%; the Stress scenario (multiple, EV missing) is all gaps and its series label is the bare scenario name. No gap is drawn as 0.
A known enterprise value of 0 gives known 0 recoveries for Downside and Stress: plotted at zero, not gaps, not n/a.
Downside and Stress EV missing: their recoveries are gap marks; Base stays 100.0%.
Claims missing: every recovery is a gap; no mark is plottable, so the chart is kind na with the module reason.
Q-C4: series are Base 4.00x, Downside 3.00x, Stress 2.00x from T4E.3.v0N.scenario and .multiple, not the design's 'Merger value (cited EV)', 'Downside 5.0x', 'Stress 4.0x'.
Every multiple is analyst_judgment, so every bar is hatched and the legend says 'hatched = illustrative'; a missing multiple hatches by default.

scope_limits: Draws T4E.5 recovery only; the fulcrum marker of the design twin (T4E.7), EV table (T4E.3) and vs-first pp (T4E.5.vs_first_pp) are table facts, not marks of this figure.
Lease claims are excluded (G38 in the design); CP-4C settles creditor classes of the supplied pack only.
All multiples are analyst assumptions; the figure is illustrative as CP-4C's own limitation says.
